🎥🎬: Hulk (2003)

Scientist Bruce Banner is exposed to a massive dose of gamma radiation during a failed experiment, causing him to transform into a powerful green creature whenever his emotions become uncontrollable. Struggling to understand his new abilities, Bruce searches for answers while trying to escape those who want to use his power.

As the military hunts him down, led by General Thunderbolt Ross, Bruce is forced to confront his painful past and the emotional trauma that shaped him. His battle becomes not only a fight for survival but also a struggle to control the rage within himself.

Directed by Ang Lee, Hulk explores the psychological side of the character, blending superhero action with themes of identity, anger, and self-discovery.

source_details.synopsis: Hulk (also known as The Hulk) is a 2003 American superhero film based on the Marvel Comics character created by Stan Lee and Jack Kirby. The film was directed by Ang Lee and written by John Turman, James Schamus, and Michael France. Eric Bana stars as Bruce Banner and Ang Lee (through motion capture) as Hulk, alongside Jennifer Connelly, Sam Elliott, Josh Lucas, and Nick Nolte. The film explores Bruce Banner's origins. After a lab accident involving gamma radiation, he transforms into a giant green-skinned humanoid with superhuman strength known as the Hulk whenever stressed or emotionally provoked. The United States military pursues him, and he clashes with his biological father. Developmen
